expected_invariant: At all four corners of each route's derated tolerance box the exactly perturbed route stays within the spec.
experiment: Integrate each route with Jacobi fields, allocate tolerances to first order, evaluate the exact perturbation at the four box corners, derate where a corner exceeds the spec, re-verify, rank.
failure_modes_checked: exact perturbation at all four box corners

checks.reference: max realized / spec over the four corners of every route's derated tolerance box (exact perturbation)
min realized / spec (the allocation is not vacuous)

basis.derivation: first order: tolerance = spec / (2 max |j|) per error source (half the spec each, worst case); then derated by the worst exact corner ratio

findings.claim: The dome loosens the heading tolerance of the straight route relative to a flat plate of equal length
The robot, fixture and frame calibration achieves the required heading and lateral tolerances

hypothesis: The calibration tolerance a route requires is the inverse of its Jacobi sensitivity: routes whose heading field j_head grows least tolerate the largest heading calibration error; the first-order allocation must be derated where second-order terms push a tolerance corner past the spec.
input_data: Fan of geodesic routes from the station (-60, 0) mm at 0..25 deg to the far edge x = 140 mm
mathematical_model: Lateral error e(s) = delta j_lat(s) + dtheta j_head(s) + O(2); first order delta_req = spec / (2 max|j_lat|), dtheta_req = spec / (2 max|j_head|); both derated by the worst exact corner ratio until all four corners are within 0.9999 of the spec; flat reference spec / (2 L).
numerical_result: Ranking by heading tolerance: fan+0deg 2.316 mrad, fan+5deg 1.977 mrad, fan+10deg 1.476 mrad, fan+15deg 1.162 mrad, fan+20deg 1.027 mrad, fan+25deg 0.971 mrad. First-order corner ratios reach 1.0091 (fan+15deg, fan+20deg, fan+25deg derated by 0.92%, 0.24%, 0.04%).
observation_model: No observation: required tolerances are model outputs.

physical_validation_status.statement: Physical validation requires acquired hardware evidence; none was acquired for this task.

unresolved_assumptions: Tolerances are allocated half to lateral and half to heading error; other splits rescale every heading tolerance by the same factor and leave the first-order ranking unchanged.
Only the corners of the tolerance box are evaluated exactly; interior points are covered by the linear model (where the error is maximal at a corner) plus the small second-order terms.
Tape or robot path-following error along the route (after the start) is not included.
